Neil Young has recorded dozens of great songs which he has not made available to the public.  Then there's demos, live versions etc, and I have a nice chunk of them on "bootleg" discs. The minute one of them turns up officially, on a box set, a remaster, an archival release, even an official download, than they become fair game for this board.  Until then, they're off limits.
